utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, Saturday, 10 to 4, Maple Street. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Wait, Bo, I thought it was at the community center, not Maple Street, and 10 AM to whenever.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I think Leo said Maple Street. I might've misheard though.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye! I'm so glad you're here. The repair drive is this Sunday at the community center—I was hoping you could help me coordinate the volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I thought it was next Saturday. But either way, I'm happy to help coordinate volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I know, the date changed from Saturday to Sunday. Thanks for being flexible, Faye—I really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, that's right! I remember now. I have some old wires and a wrench in my garage that I can contribute.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Oren! Every bit helps. I'll be there Saturday morning too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning, you say? I'll set an alarm so I don't forget. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah! Are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday? It's at 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. This Saturday at 10, at the community center on Main Street. I think I can make it, though I might be a bit late.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries if you're late, we'll be there all morning. Just come when you can!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The repair drive is Saturday at 9 at the community center—can you make it?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'll be there! Though I heard it might not have enough power—hope that's not true.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I'll bring an extension cord just in case—we can run it from the center's back room.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this weekend? We could use your help—want to join?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I know. Saturday at the garage, 10 to 4. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Leo! Glad you're in. What kind of tools are you bringing?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, did Vik say 10 AM or 9 AM for the repair drive? I'm a bit confused.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think Vik said 10 AM, but I'm not certain. You might want to double-check with him.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Actually, I'm pretty sure I heard 9 AM from someone else. I'll plan on 9 to be safe.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center? It's from 9 AM to 3 PM.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I thought I heard it was at the old warehouse on Maple Street. Are you sure about the community center?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I'm sure—it's definitely at the community center. The warehouse thing might have been last year's event.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what do you need me to bring on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Bring any broken small appliances or electronics you want fixed, and if you have spare parts or tools, that'd help too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. I have an old blender and some screwdrivers. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Hana, the repair drive is this Saturday from 9am to 3pm at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, is this repair drive for fixing the community center itself, or for residents to bring in their own household items?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, it's for residents to bring in their own household items—appliances and such. We're fixing them up for folks in need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'll check my things and see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Rey! The drive is this Saturday at my place at 9 AM. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, see you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Kira, are you planning to go to the repair drive? It's at the old warehouse on Maple Street.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is actually going to work? I've heard some doubts about its power.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I've heard some doubts too, but I trust the organizers have it figured out. Plus, it's the only option for getting our appliances fixed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The repair drive is this Saturday morning at Cleo's place.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Actually, Rey, it's at the community center this Saturday at 10 AM, not Cleo's place.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, my mistake. Thanks for the update, Vik.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Right, Saturday 10-4. Got it. I'll try to swing by.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, see you there! Just to double-check, I thought it was 9 AM? Vik mentioned 10, but I'm not sure.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nah, pretty sure it's 10. See you there—gotta run!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I still have my doubts about it having enough power.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Power? Uh, I thought we were just fixing things with hammers and screwdrivers. What kind of power do you mean?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The repair drive—some kind of device, I think it needs a power source to work. Pia mentioned it might not have enough juice.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, I'm also worried about whether the drive itself is reliable, you know, it's an old model and might malfunction.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The old warehouse on Maple Street is sturdy—should handle the drive just fine.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: But we don't know if the drive's power output is consistent; we should test it before we start any repairs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Sam, heard about the repair drive. How's it going?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It's going well! Leo's fixing up old bikes for the kids, and I'm helping with the gears.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great to hear! But I ran into Kira, and she mentioned it might not have enough power for all the repairs. Are you guys worried about that?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: The repair drive is this Saturday at 9 AM at my place. I've got supplies ready, just need folks to show up with their broken items!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Cleo, there's been a change! The repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at your place.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Wait, what? I thought we had it all set for Saturday at my place. Who told you about the change?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: So Quinn, just to confirm—are we fixing personal household items or only things for the community center?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's for personal items too! Bring whatever needs fixing—toasters, lamps, anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Alright, thanks for clearing that up. So I'll gather my broken toaster and see you at the community center this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Gus! I heard the repair drive is this Saturday at the old warehouse on Maple Street. I'm thinking of bringing my broken toaster.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Actually, Nell, it's at my garage on Elm Street, not the old warehouse. Same time, 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks for the correction! I'm glad I can still bring my toaster. What's the address on Elm Street?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? It's at 10 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Actually, Jules, I heard it's from 9 AM to 3 PM, not 10. I'm planning to be there right at 9.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Eli! I must have mixed up the time. I'll make sure to let Hana know too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Leo, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's at the garage, not the community center. Saturday 10 to 4.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you're right, I must have mixed it up! Thanks for the correction.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: So, Oren, are we still on for next Saturday? I can start rounding up volunteers from the school.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, next Saturday! Thanks for reminding me.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll send out a sign-up sheet to the parent group tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We've got a few homes with leaky faucets and a community bench that needs reassembling. Your hammer will come in handy!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So what time are we starting, and where should I drop off my blender?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We start at 9 AM this Saturday at the community center. And you can bring your blender—we might use it for smoothies during the break!
